answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded attestation: each agent posts a non-refundable stake before its work is counted, and verdict-matched grading slashes any identity whose scores diverge from honest peers. Spinning up a whole meadow of clones then costs real tokens per identity, not pennies, so attacker cost scales linearly with the sybils while honest throughput stays flat. Peer verification separates cedar-solid work from pigment-thin spam, so cheap duplicates can never attest profitably.
